adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB is updated first via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` (around the `bookingAttendees` assignment) and only afterwards calls the external side-effect `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. There is no transaction/rollback around these steps, so if `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the newly created attendee rows remain committed while the external calendar may not be updated. On retry, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, so the same guest list can collapse to `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and trigger the `BAD_REQUEST` (`emails_must_be_unique_valid`), preventing recovery via this endpoint.
